notes.title: Community update devstream today!
notes.notes:
We've got quite a lot of news to share with you today, so you might wanna drop by our community update devstream, which starts around 4pm CET on our Twitch channel
PS. If you can't make it, worry not - we'll share the whole thing on our YT channel soon afterwards.

notes.title: Open Beta, Pre-Order and Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
Dear fans!

Plenty of great news today!

Open Beta just started!

We're excited to announce that the multiplayer open beta version of Ancerstors Legacy is now available to everyone! See you on the battlefield!


Pre-Orders are starting right now!

It's official! Ancestors Legacy will be released on May 22nd, 2018! We're now offering you the chance to pre-purchase the game for a discounted price. You will also receive two cool digital gifts completely for free - the official soundtrack composed by Adam Skorupa and Wierzynkiewicz, and also the official artbook.

Digital goods will be available once the full game is released on May 22nd, 2018!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28748587/2091b8e9b32ad7df0247f6136c896ba38ab73d96.jpg

Head over to the store page to learn more!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/620590/Ancestors_Legacy/


New trailer is here!

To celebrate the start of open beta and preorders, we decided to give you one more extra treat: a new trailer. This one is focused on all four nations of the game and their prayers. Enjoy it here on Steam or on Youtube!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JMnBwy2VKmA
